nodes.description: Address of the contract owner; sole authority for privileged functions.
Public mapping of token balances used by transferFrom/batchSend without SafeMath.
Public nested mapping of allowances mutated by approve and transferFrom.
Private mapping counting per-address sales, incremented in transferFrom.
Private whitelist mapping consulted by ensure to bypass sale limits.
Private minimum sale amount set in init.
Private maximum sale amount set in init.
Private maximum number of sales per address set in init.
Address whitelisted in ensure and set by setTradeAddress.
Public total supply assigned inside the constructor.
Public payable transfer() that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,...).
Internal view whitelist gate: returns true for owner, UNI, pair or canSale addresses, else calls condition.
Public payable transferFrom performing raw unchecked balance/allowance arithmetic and ensure() gate.
Public payable approve writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view sale-limit checker applying _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale bounds.
Owner-only delegatecall to an arbitrary address and payload.
Owner-only initializer that sets sale limits using unchecked multiplication.
Owner-only batch transfer looping over _tos with unchecked total and balance arithmetic.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Internal pure Uniswap-style pair address derivation used by ensure.
Payable constructor setting owner, supply and allowances.
msg.sender, the caller-controlled address used for authentication and authorization.
Low-level delegatecall with attacker-supplied target and calldata.
Unchecked subtraction on allowance/balance mappings in transferFrom and batchSend (Solidity 0.5.x).
Unchecked multiplication in init (token*10**decimals) and batchSend (_value*_tos.length).
Local variable holding the computed pair address in ensure.
_from parameter of transferFrom/ensure, the debited account.
_to parameter of transfer, the credited account.
_value parameter of transferFrom, the transferred amount.
_spender parameter of approve, the address granted allowance.
_tos array parameter of batchSend, recipient list.
addr parameter of setTradeAddress, the new trade address.
saleNum parameter of init, the per-address sale cap.
token parameter of init, the minimum sale amount.
maxToken parameter of init, the maximum sale amount.
a parameter of delegate, the delegatecall target address.
b parameter of delegate, the delegatecall payload bytes.
Local total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend.
Loop counter i in batchSend's recipient loop.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared to _from to decide whether the allowance branch must be executed in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the owner key written into allowance during approve.
transfer forwards msg.sender as the _from argument to transferFrom.
msg.sender must equal owner before the delegatecall is executed in delegate.
msg.sender must equal owner before sale parameters are initialized in init.
msg.sender must equal owner before batchSend distributes balances.
msg.sender must equal owner before tradeAddress can be replaced.
constructor records msg.sender as the privileged owner.
_from selects the balance and allowance entries modified by transferFrom.
_value is subtracted from allowances and balances with unchecked operator.
transferFrom mutates allowance and balanceOf using unchecked -= on a caller-controlled amount.
init computes token*10**decimals with unchecked multiplication.
batchSend computes _value*_tos.length with unchecked multiplication.
The payload of delegate flows into a delegatecall to an arbitrary attacker-supplied address.
The delegatecall transfers execution context to arbitrary code that can re-enter the contract.
transferFrom reverts unless the internal ensure gate returns true.
ensure derives the pair address through pairFor before whitelist comparison.
ensure delegates the sale-limit decision to condition, gating non-whitelisted senders.
transfer unconditionally invokes transferFrom.
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf entries.
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance entries.
approve writes the allowance mapping.
Constructor assigns the owner state variable.
Constructor derives owner from the untrusted msg.sender.
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress state variable.
addr parameter is stored into tradeAddress.
init writes _minSale.
init writes _maxSale.
init writes _saleNum.
ensure grants an unconditional bypass when the sender is tradeAddress.
ensure grants an unconditional bypass when canSale[_from] is true.
ensure grants an unconditional bypass when _from or _to is the owner.
ensure participates in the sale counting logic backed by _onSaleNum.
ensure stores the computed pair address in the local _UNI variable for comparison.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] after balance updates.
_to parameter is forwarded by transfer to transferFrom.
_spender parameter is the allowance key written by approve.
_tos array drives the batchSend credit loop.
The local total is produced by an unchecked multiplication of _value and _tos.length.
The unchecked total is compared against and subtracted from balanceOf[msg.sender].
Loop counter i controls iteration over the _tos recipients.
saleNum parameter is assigned to _saleNum.
token parameter feeds the unchecked token*10**decimals computation.
maxToken parameter feeds the unchecked maxToken*10**decimals computation.
Target address a is passed to delegatecall, allowing arbitrary code execution.
Calldata b is passed to delegatecall, allowing arbitrary function dispatch.

normalization_plan.reason: Local pair address is only used inside ensure for the whitelist comparison and has no independent semantics.
_from is the source account selected by transferFrom and carries no standalone behavior.
_to is only meaningful as the recipient argument consumed by transfer.
_value is the amount whose unchecked subtraction is the arithmetic risk in transferFrom.
_spender is only the allowance key of approve.
_tos exists only to drive the batchSend recipient loop.
addr is directly stored into tradeAddress by setTradeAddress.
saleNum is directly assigned to _saleNum inside init.
token is an operand of the unchecked multiplication in init.
maxToken is an operand of the unchecked multiplication in init.
a is the arbitrary target of the delegatecall in delegate.
b is the arbitrary calldata of the delegatecall in delegate.
total only exists to hold the unchecked product used by batchSend.
Loop index i only controls the batchSend iteration.
